_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F03, a rescue: the baker goes home (the elder's quest, the village bakery).

text.zh_TW: 麵包師被綁在柱子上，嘴裡塞著自己的圍裙。「嗚嗚嗚！」
text.en: The baker is tied to a post, gagged with his own apron. "Mmmph!"

text.zh_TW: 麵包師：「里歐！我看到他們把你爸媽往上帶……灰面說，要帶去見『主人』。」他擦擦眼睛。「回村後，我烤麵包給你吃，吃到飽！」
text.en: Baker: "Leo! I saw them take your parents further up... Grey Mask said they were for 'the Master'." He wipes his eyes. "When I'm home I'll bake for you. All you can eat!"
